explanation: Script reads of published bundles now go through scripts/lib/bundleReader.mts everywhere a dataset change is consumed: the query index, expression index, bundle optimizer, upload guards, deploy verifier and SEO study pages. The dataset-change route names listDiskCorpus as the one sweep of public/datasets and states that a directory the registry does not name is reported and never read; CONTEXT.md and the refactor checklist record the same rule. Review follow-up: the reduced-release macaque check covers every track_<id>.js in the folder as well as the declared tracks, so a missing meta.js or an undeclared file cannot pass unchecked (deployGuards.test.ts).
